title: Catalogue of Hittite Texts
author: Ancient
content:
Catalog of Hittite Texts (CTH)

In 1971 Emmanuel Laroche published his 
Catalogue des textes hittites
, which facilitated Hittite studies as no other work has.  The CTH has become the standard catalog used by Hittitologists in referring to the Hittite text corpus.  Because that corpus continues to grow, the need to keep the CTH updated is a current and pervasive problem.  The creation of the World Wide Web makes it possible to do this.  The following represents only a beginning in this process of updating the CTH.  It is, and always will be, a work in progress.  I do not take responsibility for inaccuracies or inconsistencies in what appears in these pages.  The purpose of this electronic edition of the CTH is to encourage Hittitologists to submit updates and corrections, so that it will stay current, and continue to be a vital resource for Hittitology.  Toward this end, suggestions, corrections and updates should be sent to:  
Dr. Billie Jean Collins, Department of Near Eastern Studies, S318 Callaway Center, Emory University, Atlanta, GA  30322  USA, (404) 727-0807.  E-mail:  bcollin@emory.edu
